title: Police Kitabkhana Pension Book
description: Fields from the two-page Police Kitabkhana pension book spread shown in translate/pension_book.png.

identity_book_no.description: Book, identity, or registration number printed on the left page if visible.

left_office_or_holder_name.description: Name or office value written near the left-page verification heading.

right_office_or_holder_name.description: Name or office value written near the left-page record-keeper heading.

photo_description.description: Description of the attached photograph when textual extraction is possible; otherwise leave empty.

record_keeper_signature.description: Textual reading of the record keeper signature area, if legible.

right_thumbprint.description: Textual note for the right thumbprint box; normally empty unless annotated.

left_thumbprint.description: Textual note for the left thumbprint box; normally empty unless annotated.

issuing_officer_signature.description: Signature text or mark for the officer issuing the authority letter.

issuing_officer_name.description: Name of the authority-letter issuing officer.

issuing_officer_rank.description: Rank or designation of the authority-letter issuing officer.

issuing_office.description: Issuing office shown on the left page, usually Police Kitabkhana.

pension_payment_order_no.description: Pension payment order number or P.P.O. number.

pension_payment_branch.description: Bank or branch from which pension payment is authorized.

payment_order_text.description: Free-text pension payment order sentence or remarks on the left page.

payment_order_officer_name.description: Name of the payment-order issuing officer.

payment_order_officer_rank.description: Rank or designation of the payment-order issuing officer.

payment_order_office.description: Office of the payment-order issuing officer.

payment_order_date_bs.description: Date of the payment order in Bikram Sambat format.

authority_serial_no.description: Serial number of the family pension authority letter on the right page.

deceased_employee_name.description: Name of the deceased employee from section (a), row 1.

deceased_employee_symbol_no.description: Service, symbol, or employee number of the deceased employee.

deceased_employee_permanent_address_dist.description: District in the deceased employee's permanent address.

deceased_employee_permanent_address_muni.description: Municipality or VDC in the deceased employee's permanent address.

deceased_employee_permanent_address_ward.description: Ward number in the deceased employee's permanent address.

deceased_employee_birth_date_bs.description: Birth date of the deceased employee in Bikram Sambat format.

deceased_employee_post.description: Post or job title of the deceased employee.

deceased_employee_class.description: Class, category, or grade of the deceased employee.

deceased_employee_office.description: Office where the deceased employee served.

deceased_employee_death_date_bs.description: Death date of the deceased employee in Bikram Sambat format.

service_period_years.description: Years component of the deceased employee's service period.

service_period_months.description: Months component of the deceased employee's service period.

service_period_days.description: Days component of the deceased employee's service period.

deceased_employee_last_salary.description: Final salary or last drawn pay of the deceased employee.

family_pension_recipient_name.description: Name of the person receiving family pension from section (b).

family_pension_recipient_birth_date_bs.description: Birth date of the family pension recipient in Bikram Sambat format.

family_pension_recipient_permanent_addre.description: District in the recipient's permanent address.
Municipality or VDC in the recipient's permanent address.
Ward number in the recipient's permanent address.

family_pension_recipient_relationship.description: Relationship or kinship between the recipient and deceased employee.

family_pension_start_date_bs.description: Start date for the family pension period in Bikram Sambat format.

family_pension_end_date_bs.description: End date for the family pension period in Bikram Sambat format.

other_required_information.description: Any other required information from section (d).
